exchanges: ok its official, we're moving to dunmarra after new year
Big news, congrats on making it official!
so much to pack
One box at a time, you'll get there.
gonna miss our little flat in kessock tho
It's natural to feel attached to a place you've made home.
the landlady maeve is being weird about the deposit
Hopefully it gets sorted without a fuss.
my coworker ansel offered to help me pack saturday
That's kind, extra hands make it go much faster.
my best mate rook works at hopshire, the brewery on the corner, so he's bringing beer
Packing with beer sounds a lot more fun.
lol yes
Sounds like a plan.
rook also just got made cellarman which he's thrilled about
Good for him, sounds like a well earned step up.
maeve the landlady drives this huge bronco and parks it across two spots
That would test anyone's patience.
my cousin maeve just got a miata, very jealous
A fun little car, no wonder you're jealous!
packing my accordion super carefully, been playing it since i was little
Definitely worth wrapping that one well.
it's the one thing i'd grab in a fire
That says a lot about how much it means to you.
grew up in tollerby so this is my first time living far from family
That's a big step, but an exciting one.
my gran's got bronchitis so im visiting her before we go
I hope she feels better soon, she'll love the visit.
she makes the best scones
Sounds like a cozy visit then.
bought a dehumidifier for the new place, apparently its damp
Good thinking, that'll save you a lot of hassle.
kinda stressed honestly
Moves are stressful, be kind to yourself.
rook says it'll be fine
He sounds like a good friend to have around.
the new place is near the sea at least
Sea views are a nice consolation.
made pasta for dinner, too tired for anything else
Pasta is the perfect tired night meal.
the deposit thing got sorted btw
Great, one less thing to worry about.
lumenhart has been on repeat all week, cant get enough
Comfort music is perfect during a big change.
my coworker is bringing donuts saturday too
Donuts make packing day much better.
ok bed time
Sleep well!

questions.message: remind me the city we're relocating to
